# BlackHole-derived virtual microphone

`scripts/build-virtual-microphone.sh` fetches BlackHole `v0.7.1` at commit
`e2b22aaaba4e507a097131704bf96dabc004d9cf` and applies the adjacent patch.
The result is an independently identified two-channel HAL device named
`Codyboard Virtual Microphone`.
